_doc: VTID-05183 — inputs of scripts/native/gen-core-extract.mjs, the single extraction generator of the native program. Each entry becomes packages/core/src/extracted/<entry>.generated.ts with the named declarations copied verbatim from the web source. A take is a top-level name or Function#local (a pure-literal const in a named top-level function); {"name", "as"} exports it under another name. iconFields: icon identifiers become their name as a string, the field type becomes IconName. stubs: identifier -> expression, each with a reason. When a module later moves physically (program step 3), its entry is deleted and core re-exports the moved module instead.

getCommandHubUrl.reason: Only the developer/infra branches read the Command Hub URL (devHub config, import.meta.env). Both are MOBILE_EXCLUDED_ROLES, so computeAvailableRoles never offers them on mobile (apps/mobile/tests/core/roles.test.ts proves the branch unreachable).

MatchReason.expression: string | { code: string; params?: Record<string, string | number> }
MatchReason.reason: VTID-05297: MatchReason is `import type`-only from the class-B src/lib/matchReason.ts (it has a runtime `import { t }` reaching import.meta-using web files). The native feed only needs its shape, which is reproduced here verbatim (string | { code; params? }) so no web class-B file enters the native strict TS program. matchReason/post-attachment are deliberately not in the core closure (core-closure --check).

PostAttachedRef.expression: { type: 'community_event' | 'live_room_session' | 'calendar_entry'; id: string; snapshot?: { title: string; start_time: string; end_time: string | null; location: string | null; emoji: string | null; status: string } }
PostAttachedRef.reason: VTID-05297: PostAttachedRef is `import type`-only from the class-B src/lib/post-attachment.ts (runtime supabase import). Its shape is reproduced here verbatim (PostAttachedRef + AttachedSnapshot inlined) so the ranker's PostFeedItem.attached_ref keeps correct typing without pulling the web class-B file into the native strict TS program.
